source: Bombardier Learjet 60 AFM FM-123 (Change 37), Section V performance data, transcribed from the scan on archive.org. Numbers only; see figure/page per table.

conditions.n1_values: compensated (with ENG SYNC on, displayed N1 may read lower than chart)

conditions.anti_ice: table is uncorrected (anti-ice OFF, zero wind); correct with the chart on the same page (not digitized)

conditions.speed_schedule_basis: approximates best rate-of-climb speed; above single-engine ceiling, minimum sink-rate speed
